name: Hazel's Sacrifice -Spectator Round Two-
source:
The second spectator round made for DreamCatcherOCT. You play as a fairy who survived being in a hospital full of monsters only to be horribly injured as soon as she escapes. She meets a god who demands a sacrifice in exchange for her life.

What will she offer?
